title: Formation & Pre-Debut Activities
description: Global audition preparations under Min Hee-jin's direction leading to the launch of ADOR, establishing the debut member lineup.

title: Surprise Debut with 'Attention'
description: NewJeans made an unprecedented surprise debut with the 'Attention' music video, followed by 'Hype Boy', 'Cookie', and 'Hurt'.

title: 'Ditto' Phenomenon & Single Album 'OMG'
description: 'Ditto' became the longest-running #1 song on Korea's Circle Digital Chart (13 weeks) and entered the Billboard Hot 100 & UK Official Charts.

title: 2nd EP 'Get Up' & #1 Billboard 200 Debut
description: Released 'Get Up' with title tracks 'Super Shy', 'ETA', and 'Cool With You', debuting at #1 on the Billboard 200 and performing at Lollapalooza.

title: Double Single 'How Sweet' & Japan Debut
description: Returned with Miami Bass hit 'How Sweet' & 'Bubble Gum', followed by their official Japanese debut single 'Supernatural'.

title: Contract Evolution & Danielle Archive Era
description: Following contract discussions, Danielle's exclusive contract concluded, with her legacy officially preserved in the Former Member Archive.

title: 4-Member Active Re-Activation
description: NewJeans launched the '2026 Summer of NewJeans' campaign, continuing active group engagements with Minji, Hanni, Haerin, and Hyein.
